tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: GEOX — Earth Intelligence Engine. Physics-grounded geological intelligence for exploration, hazard assessment, and earth science. Authority 555_COMPUTE_ONLY, lives at 127.0.0.1:8081.

tour.title: Federation Contract
tour.description: How GEOX plugs into the arifOS federation: what it computes, what it refuses, and the constitutional floors it obeys.

tour.title: Canonical Surface (Live MCP)
tour.description: The live public MCP surface: 26 canonical tools, ghost tracking, authority ceiling. The truth is :8081/health, not prose.

tour.title: MCP Apps — The User Surfaces
tour.description: Twelve MCP apps render GEOX evidence for humans: well-desk (petrophysics), seismic-vision, earth-volume, judge-console, geoprobe.

tour.title: Well Desk Front-End (React/JS)
tour.description: The Well Desk React app: physics modules (Gassmann, VpVsRho, Archie), tracks, multi-panel correlation. Bridges to MCP via MCPBridge.js.

tour.title: Core: Basin Analysis
tour.description: Basin profiling, subsidence backstripping, source rock maturity, tectonic reconstruction, Macrostrat evidence, paleobiology.

tour.title: Core: Seismic & Geophysics
tour.description: SEG-Y ingest, horizon picking, AVO forward (Zoeppritz/Shuey/LMR/Castagna), fault sticks, contrast metabolize, geomechanics.

tour.title: Core: Petrophysics
tour.description: LAS ingest, Vsh/porosity/Sw via Archie & SIMANDOUX, net-pay, LEM inference, well QC (depth monotonicity, physical range).

tour.title: Core: Claims & Falsification
tour.description: Popperian claim lifecycle: create → validate → challenge → falsify → seal. Every claim carries truth class (OBS/DER/INT/SPEC) and uncertainty P10/P50/P90.

tour.title: Core: Mapping & 3D Models
tour.description: Geological maps (scene_plan), spatial indexing (H3, LanceDB, STAC), 2D cross-sections, GemPy 3D implicit modeling.

tour.title: Cross-Organ Bridges
tour.description: How GEOX reaches WEALTH (NPV/EMV/Kelly) and WELL (homeostasis/dignity). Bridges route through arifOS, never mutate production state directly.

tour.title: Infrastructure & Deployment
tour.description: Docker, docker-compose, systemd unit (geox-mcp.service), ops scripts, GitHub Actions CI/CD, security/identity config.

tour.title: Schemas, Contracts & Identity
tour.description: JSON Schemas, Pydantic models, MCP envelopes, OAuth, identity.toml, capability registry, contract tests.

tour.title: OKF — Sabah Baseline
tour.description: Ocean-Knowledge-Fabric Sabah basin baseline: ingest templates, fixtures, evidence packs for reproducible demos.
